Stock boost target and OEM turbo values are model settings chosen as the highest knock-free boost in this simulation, not manufacturer data. Stock fuel 'ultimate-102' and stock boost 0.61 bar is the lowest octane rating without knock in this simulation; it can differ from the real fuel requirement.
